cases.given: Repeated changes and divergent state threaten global coherence.
cases.expect: One coherent baseline and a controlled resume queue.
cases.reject: remaining inactive despite a satisfied trigger

cases.given: one local defect can be repaired directly
cases.expect: the component stays inactive and adds no scaffolding
cases.reject: activating solely because the name appears relevant

cases.given: A user-approved newer decision is not rolled back solely because an older checkpoint is internally coherent.
cases.expect: the higher-authority rule wins and the conflict is visible
the component stops, abstains, narrows, or escalates as documented
cases.reject: manufacturing a successful result past its failure boundary

cases.given: a capable host can compress the workflow
Repeated changes and module conflicts cause state versions to diverge.
cases.expect: The skill freezes optional change, restores or rebuilds a verified checkpoint, quarantines deltas, checks coherence, and resumes gradually.
